title: Yummy Peruvian Quinoa Bowl
description: A salty, bouncy-qq quinoa bowl packed with Peruvian flavors and post-workout protein, using dried oregano and finished in a stone-bowl-dolsot to keep it low-calorie friendly.
instructions: Combine quinoa and water in a pot and bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until tender, about 15 minutes.
Stir in black beans and diced bell peppers, heat through for 3 minutes.
In a separate pan, heat olive oil and sear the grilled chicken slices until warmed, about 2 minutes.
Transfer the quinoa mixture to a stone-bowl-dolsot, maintaining a gentle heat.
Add the seared chicken on top of the quinoa.
Drizzle lime juice, low sodium soy sauce, and dried oregano over the bowl.
Garnish with diced avocado and a sprinkle of fresh cilantro.
Serve immediately, letting the bowl stay warm in the dolsot for a bouncy-qq texture.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
